a.lede: The protesters stormed over the walls and took over the construction site, with the Stop Dirty Data Centers coalition saying that more actions are planned across Europe.
a.title: Protesters storm Microsoft AI data center construction site

b.lede: It's unclear which group entered the construction site first, but the action led to the arrest of 150 to 200 protesters.
b.title: Hundreds arrested after Microsoft data center protest turns violent
